{{Quote|What is it? Don't you know how ''hard'' it is to keep this thing running?! I don't need any&mdash;interruptions!|translated=1|Bogg, confronted by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="BTB" />}}
'''Bogg''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who designed and operated the [[Tank/Legends|landtank]] known as the ''[[Bogg Behemoth]]''. Bogg was captured<ref name="BTB" /> and imprisoned<ref name="UTH">{{SWComicCite|7.6|Under the Hammer}}</ref> by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] during a land [[Battle of Makem Te (Clone Wars)|battle]] before the Geonosian could use his weapon against the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Thousand Thousand]].<ref name="BTB" /> Bogg's last surviving creation, the ''[[Venomator]]'', eventually found it's way onto the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] and was eventually obtained by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] outlaw [[Clawfish]]. It was eventually destroyed.<ref name="UTH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bogg first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.17|17th issue]] of the 6th volume of the [[Star Wars Comic]] UK comic line, published by [[Titan Magazines]] on [[February 10]], [[2011]].<ref name="BTB" />
